description: The manifest's compiled headless and native Vulkan suites on a physical iOS device (arm64, the iOS product profile's toolchain, SDK and deployment target). tools/quality/ios_conformance.py cross-compiles each suite on Linux into its own Mach-O module object (ld64 -r, one exported entry, everything else localized, as static composition does), links them into one test-host app with SDL3 and MoltenVK, installs it with ios-deploy.sh and launches it once per suite through devicectl, so every suite runs in its own process. Results use the shared checks-v1 classification (conformance.classify_run). GPU suites present through UIKit and MoltenVK rather than SDL's offscreen driver. Not loaded by conformance.py: no manifest suite names this profile; the host profiles are listed in `hosts`.

unsupported.shared-unit: builds a first-party shared library at run time; the iOS profile links first-party code statically and loads no first-party module
unsupported.sanitizer: needs a sanitizer runtime the iOS profile does not ship (TSan runs on the Linux lanes)
unsupported.libstdcxx-dual-abi: seeds a libstdc++ dual-ABI mismatch (_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI); the iOS toolchain's libc++ has one ABI, so the seeded defect cannot exist there

platform_defines._comment: Suite rows that declare Linux platform defines compile with the iOS product's instead (wscript's iOS defines): the code the app ships.

include_after_comment: ARM targets find sse2neon.h (public/mathlib/ssemath.h) in common/, as the product's targets include it; searched last so it shadows nothing.

programs._comment: Benchmark hosts the budget tools drive (physics_bench.py, scheduler_budgets.py --ios). Sources, includes, defines and uses come from the named Waf target (its wscript is the owner); they compile with the iOS product's release flags and link the iOS build's own libraries and module objects (program_uses).

program_uses._comment: Waf uselib -> the iOS build's output a program links (build-ios-app.sh builds them). Uselibs not listed (DL, LOG) are system facilities on iOS.
